basic.name: Fleeting Fragrance
basic.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Argenti's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Justice, Hereby Blooms
skill.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{skill_damage}}% of Argenti's ATK to all enemies.

ultimate.name: For In This Garden, Supreme Beauty Bestows
ultimate.description_template: Consumes 90 Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to {{ult_damage}}% of Argenti's ATK to all enemies.

variants.name: Merit Bestowed in "My" Garden
variants.description_template: Consumes 180 Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to {{first_hit}}% of Argenti's ATK to all enemies. And further deals DMG for 6 extra time(s), with each time dealing Physical DMG equal to {{bounce_hit}}% of Argenti's ATK to a random enemy.

talent.name: Sublime Object
talent.description_template: For every enemy hit when Argenti uses his Basic Attack, Skill, or Ultimate, regenerates Argenti's Energy by 3, and grants him a stack of Apotheosis, increasing his CRIT Rate by {{crit_buff}}%. This effect can stack up to 10 time(s).

technique.name: Manifesto of Purest Virtue
technique.description: After using the Technique, enemies in a set area are inflicted with Daze for 10 second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack the team. When attacking a Dazed enemy to enter combat, deals Physical DMG to all enemies equal to 80% of Argenti's ATK and regenerates his Energy by 15.

2.name: Piety
2.description: At the start of a turn, immediately gains 1 stack(s) of Apotheosis.

4.name: Generosity
4.description: When enemy targets enter combat, immediately regenerates 2 Energy for self.

6.name: Courage
6.description: Deals 15% more DMG to enemies whose HP percentage is 50% or less.

eidolons.name: A Lacuna in Kingdom of Aesthetics
eidolons.description: Each stack of Apotheosis additionally increases CRIT DMG by 4%.

eidolons.name: Agate's Humility
eidolons.description: If the number of enemies on the field equals to 3 or more when the Ultimate is used, ATK increases by 40% for 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Thorny Road's Glory
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Trumpet's Dedication
eidolons.description: At the start of battle, gains 2 stack(s) of Apotheosis and increases the maximum stack limit of the Talent's effect by 2.

eidolons.name: Snow, From Somewhere in Cosmos
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: "Your" Resplendence
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, ignores 30% of enemy targets' DEF.
